name: lockimini
description: Plataforma de e-commerce completa: catalogo, carrinho, checkout, pagamentos, estoque em tempo real e painel administrativo.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
